# nps_workshop_settings_binary_upload_config (Resource)

The `nps_workshop_settings_binary_upload_config` resource manages the bucket Santa uploads binaries to when Workshop requests a binary upload.

You need the `read:settings` and `write:settings` permissions.

This is a singleton resource, one per tenant. Creating it sets the bucket URL and replaces any value the tenant already has. Destroying it removes it from state and leaves the tenant's setting as it was.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nps_workshop_settings_binary_upload_config" "settings" {
  bucket_url = "gs://north-pole-binary-uploads"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket_url` (String) The bucket URL, as `gs://bucket` or `s3://bucket`. Set it to the empty string to clear the setting, which turns binary upload off.
